che-designer-sei.description: An interactive web experience built for Talent Garden — Europe's largest tech education network — to promote their design courses. Users answer a series of personality-style questions and receive a personalised designer profile with a matching course recommendation.
highlights: Designed and built the full quiz flow with animated transitions between questions
Integrated with HubSpot CMS for lead capture on result pages
Achieved sub-second page load on Vercel's edge network
Shipped end-to-end in under 3 weeks, from brief to production

hub-lombardini22.description: A showcase website for Hub Lombardini22, the innovation and knowledge hub of one of Italy's leading architecture and engineering firms. The site features physics-based interactive animations powered by Matter.js, content managed via a headless Strapi CMS, and a clean editorial design that reflects the firm's design philosophy.
highlights: Built a physics-based particle animation on the hero using Matter.js
Integrated a Strapi headless CMS so the editorial team can publish content independently
Implemented smooth scroll-driven section transitions for an immersive reading experience
Delivered a fully responsive layout optimised for both desktop deep-dives and mobile browsing

dpulses.description: The company website for Dpulses, a digital-first brand studio. The brief called for a bold, high-contrast visual identity translated into a fast, responsive web presence. The result is a minimal but impactful site that communicates the studio's creative positioning and drives inbound enquiries.
highlights: Translated a Figma brand concept into a pixel-perfect Next.js build
Optimised Core Web Vitals to green across all Lighthouse categories
Built with a mobile-first approach, ensuring a consistent experience at every breakpoint
Deployed on Vercel with automatic preview deployments for the client review cycle

datahause.description: The marketing website for DataHause, a data analytics and business intelligence consultancy. The site needed to convey technical credibility while remaining accessible to a non-technical audience. Clean typography, structured case-study sections, and clear calls-to-action guide visitors from awareness to contact.
highlights: Architected a component-driven layout system for rapid page assembly
Implemented structured data (JSON-LD) for improved search visibility
Built an animated stats section to highlight key business metrics
Ensured WCAG AA accessibility compliance across all interactive elements
